verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ZCode has Goal-based multi-step task management and remote triggering via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram. Nothing documents versioning, reviewing diffs of, or rolling back automation definitions. A community mention of a checkpoints directory concerns reported workspace/Git snapshot uploads, not automation version control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
